decisions.reason: The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY that fully records the INA219 position and its total downstream 3.3V measurement coverage.
The source establishes the interboard power path to the sensor board but does not change the sensor-module connector behavior owned by this Requirement.
The candidate already requires the standalone LDO to power the full shared 3.3V rail for sensor debugging; the source does not establish a different standalone-supply behavior.
The power-distribution and INA219 topology does not change I2C pull-ups, signal conditioning, bus speed, or cable constraints.
The source describes distribution downstream of the power board and does not change the AXP2101 battery, USB, VMID, or VSYS power-path requirements.
The source does not alter the BOOT button, reset connection, or associated capacitance requirements.
The source concerns board power distribution and current monitoring, not USB enumeration or programming data behavior.
The source identifies the ESP32 as a downstream load but does not change the selected module or its pin-breakout requirement.
The interboard power topology does not change the battery connector's placement, orientation, spacing, or mounting-hole clearance.
The source changes electrical interboard topology but does not entail any change to the power board's mechanical layout.
The source does not establish or revise any ESP32-S3 GPIO assignment.
Although the source names interboard connectors, it does not change their selected types, availability, cost, or sourceability policy.
